sentences.text:
THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227  OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO DIRECT THE  RESPONDENT TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATION DATED  25.10.2022 AS PER ANNEXURE-B IN RESPECT OF PROPERTY OF THE  PETITIONER AND ETC.
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-K:5477  WP No. 201918 of 2023

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.
Learned High Court Government Pleader accepts notice for the respondent.

2. The petitioner is before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
a.
Issue writ of mandamus directing the respondent to consider the representation dated 25.10.2022 as per Annexure-B in respect of property of the petitioner, in the interest of justice and equity.
b. Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in circumstances of the case, in ends of justice and equity.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that though enhanced compensation has been paid as regards similarly situated land acquired under the very same notification, the said enhanced compensation has not been made available to the petitioner.

4. Whenever any land is acquired and compensation is enhanced, it is required that all the land losers also NC: 2023:KHC-K:5477 be made available the same compensation as held by this Court in MSA.No.200186/2019 disposed of on 11.02.2021.
5.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The Writ Petition is allowed.
ii. A mandamus is issued directing the respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 25.10.2022 at Annexure-B by treating the same as an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.
Mallikarjun And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka on 18 July, 2023
